segments.text: I've been teaching English for 12 years, and since my first day, one mistake keeps coming
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker shares their 12 years of experience encountering a specific repeated error.
segments.turkishExplanation: 12 yıldır İngilizce öğretiyorum ve ilk günümdem beri tek bir hata sürekli karşıma çıkıyor.

segments.englishExplanation: Introduces what the students typically say when making this error.

segments.text: I'm living here since three years.
segments.englishExplanation: Gives an example of the incorrect sentence using 'since' with duration.

segments.text: So let me bring it up properly.
segments.englishExplanation: States the speaker's intention to explain and clarify the rule properly.

segments.text: Use four with a period of time, like for three years or for a long time.
segments.englishExplanation: Explains that 'for' is used when referring to a duration or length of time.
segments.turkishExplanation: "For" kelimesini, "üç yıldır" veya "uzun zamandır" gibi bir zaman dilimiyle kullanın.

segments.text: Use since with a starting point, like since Monday or since I was a child.
segments.englishExplanation: Explains that 'since' refers to a specific starting moment in time.
segments.turkishExplanation: "Since" kelimesini ise "Pazartesi'den beri" veya "çocukluğumdan beri" gibi bir başlangıç noktasıyla kullanın.

segments.text: And both usually need the present perfect, not the present simple.
segments.englishExplanation: Notes that both duration markers usually require the present perfect tense.
segments.turkishExplanation: Ve her ikisi de genellikle geniş zaman değil, yakın geçmiş zaman gerektirir.

segments.text: So it's, I've been living here for three years.
segments.englishExplanation: Provides the correct sentence combining present perfect and 'for'.

segments.text: Next week, we'll practice with your own stories.
segments.englishExplanation: Mentions the plan to practice this concept using personal stories next week.
segments.turkishExplanation: Gelecek hafta kendi hikayelerinizle pratik yapacağız.

segments.text: Honestly, I'm looking forward to hearing them.
segments.englishExplanation: Expresses genuine enthusiasm about listening to the students' stories.
segments.turkishExplanation: Dürüst olmak gerekirse, onları dinlemeyi iple çekiyorum.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To introduce or mention a topic for discussion.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir konuyu tartışılmak üzere gündeme getirmek veya dile getirmek.
learningPoints.exampleEn: She decided to bring up the issue in the meeting.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Toplantıda bu konuyu gündeme getirmeye karar verdi.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To feel excited and eager about something that will happen in the future.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Gelecekte gerçekleşecek bir olay için heyecan duymak ve sabırsızlanmak.
learningPoints.exampleEn: I'm looking forward to starting my new job next week.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Gelecek hafta yeni işime başlamayı iple çekiyorum.

quiz.question: In segment 10, what does the speaker mean by 'I'm looking forward to hearing them'?

options.text: They are excited and eager to listen to the stories.
They are reluctant and hesitant to listen to the stories.
They have already finished listening to all of the stories.
They are hoping the students write much shorter stories.
